1_choicePoints.audit: each branch is real content; branches re-converging to identical world facts are the named defect FALSE FORK
1_choicePoints.requirement: at least one point where the Ranger does one thing rather than another; branches are #12 fact chains per #138

2_writtenFacts.requirement: every branch writes at least one world fact in a standing vocabulary — #12 flag, #269 deed, #270-moving witnessed report, #299 membership change, a record change through a real system
2_writtenFacts.rule: a consequence that lives only in dialogue is not a consequence; the story's record names the write (which system, which fact)

3_closedDoors.declared: in the story's checklist entry: the door, the closing fact, and whether anything can reopen it
3_closedDoors.default: NEVER reopenable — #173's respect for closed flags generalised; a reopening is an authored exception, named, never a reset
3_closedDoors.requirement: at least one door the un-chosen branch held open is shut by the story's own record

4_delayedEchoes.requirement: at least one consequence surfacing later and elsewhere, delivered by the world's own systems (#93 schedule change, #145 traveller's news, #172 broadcast, #270 greeting changed)
4_delayedEchoes.rule: scheduled as a world fact with a trigger — never scripted as a cutscene ambush

note: The checklist IS the deliverable. Zero stories re-authored under it in this package — the content pass is named in STAGING.
refusalIsABranch: walking away writes the refusal fact and the story's world resolves without the Ranger (badly, or with someone else as its hero — and the echo names them). Absence costs, gently and truly
scopeLaw: #138's bars stand UNCHANGED: side stories never touch the spine or the secrets. Closed doors are side-story-scale (a trust, a local door, one road of one story) — never a region, never the league spine, never what stopped moving in the Dark Forest
